product.insight: Re-defined development planning into independent verticals with AI-integrated coding and full-stack ownership distributed feature-wise among developers - execution underway for 20th Ramzan Sprint. Backend foundation is rock-solid, but mobile stagnation is existential: we must restart Android immediately and finalize iOS strategy within 48 hours. Wallet compliance is our second-highest priority - without monetization, we have a demo, not a business.

technology.insight: Backend and admin dashboard are executing well with Docker containerization complete and auth systems robust. Post-sprint plan: migrate to microservices architecture and React frontend for improved scalability and developer experience. Critical gap: mobile engineering capacity requires immediate resourcing (reassign engineers or bring contractors). Recommend MVP scope reduction on Ride Hailing to improve launch probability.

engineering.insight: Team velocity on backend is strong (6 commits/week), but mobile silence is alarming. Android has the foundation (100 commits) - we just need resourcing. iOS is a greenfield problem requiring strategic decision. The Packages feature sync between backend/frontend proves our integration workflow works. Focus areas: 1) Mobile resourcing NOW, 2) AI feature prioritization (implement 4, defer 4), 3) Admin dashboard merge must not slip.
